title: Ritual of Time's Threshold
text: Requires one Advanced Ritual Energy Core, eight Crystal Pedestals, four Spacetime Knots, two Paradox Dust and two Infused Spiritual Crystals. Lure a Dream Mirror nearby, keep the space above the core clear, then use an Unstable Spacetime Aggregate on the core.

The mirror fixes above the core as a blue-violet rift opens. After twelve seconds only the aggregate is consumed; pedestal offerings remain. The aggregate stops decaying during formation, but breaking the core or removing an offering ejects it and triggers a spacetime storm.

The gateway lasts three minutes and turns toward approaching players. Entering takes a moment. Ordinary vehicles can cross with passengers; large mechanical structures cannot. Afterwards, a free-roaming Dream Mirror appears again.

The one-way gateway reaches a random point in the Spacetime Mirror Corridor. Its rifts can send you to random places in the upper Time Continent or lower spatial region, but none lead back. Prepare a Spacetime Waymark or another way home. The continent appears to be formed from overlapping and twisted timelines. The space beyond the corridor seems impossible to explore.
